summary: Route harness questions to an explicit agent principal or configured person

replay.detail: No history rewrite or replay rule change. The canonical desired tree retains the optional principal child.

schema.detail: Agent KDL accepts at most one principal child with exactly one canonical person ID string and no properties or body. No new claim field, claim kind or database layout.

compatibility.detail: Existing declarations remain valid. Older readers reject the principal child. Questions use the declared principal or daemon person, never inferred ownership; without either, global attention shows a configuration diagnostic. Permissions and reviews retain existing authority.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no storage migration.

manual.detail: Upgrade readers before publishing principal children. Declare a principal explicitly for portable routing, or configure the daemon person as a local fallback. No automatic backfill.

recovery.detail: Remove principal children before submitting declarations to an older grammar reader.
